editorial.blurb: Carbon is a stunning American restaurant and late-night hotspot where exceptional steaks, fresh oysters, and craft cocktails meet an electric atmosphere that transforms from fine dining to full club as the night unfolds.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive after 9 pm to experience the full Carbon magic—dine on their standout steaks and caviar while the DJ spins house and hip-hop, then watch the main floor transform into a vibrant club by 11 pm.

topDishes.note: Reviewers rave about this standout steak
